title: CYCLIC-DOUBLEBOOST: inverse-square-log blocks with squared-log boosts and signed curvature work — explicit positive-phase supplier revision

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-DOUBLEBOOST configuration in proof.md and the supplied complete source arguments recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^J2(n)). Here J2(n)=a sqrt(n)+23sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^4-180sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^8+2900sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^12 and G2(n)=a sqrt(n)-(11/2)sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^2+23sqrt(n)/(log2 n)^4-(log2 n)^2, with exact Pell rational  of cyclic_base.md Section 0. These eventual positive representative envelopes are evaluated for n>=2^4096 and extended positively on the finite smaller prefix; correctness covers every N. Constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This one configuration fixes counted x0=max(2,floor(mu/ell(mu)^2)), OTHER boost x=s=min(mu-1,x0+t^2), SEED boost x=s=min(mu-1,x0+t^2+2t), t=ceil(log2(n+2)), kappa=ceil(log2 mu)+1 for mu<65536 and kappa=2 otherwise, square-root block parameters and all actual recomputed maxima, decoder/extractor modes, precisions, confidences and separate typed caps 4096 U_seed and 4096 U_other as specified in proof.md. Every failed, rejected, discarded and cutoff-abandoned original acquisition counts. The exact growth index is 1/2. Every power-of-two leaf explicitly applies X to its original control once after LE, giving the positive phase used by wide-block readout.
